notes.title: Check out our new Teaser!
notes.content:
Good evening, retro horror fans!

We've just released the first teaser for our game IORETIN. Take a moment to watch it and learn a bit more about the story and gameplay before you play.

Make sure to add the game to your Wishlist! It will help us a lot.

Until next time!
